findings.title: L1: A16 archive-retrievability claim contradicted by bytes; dev window undefined over opening-day history
findings.detail: Draft says team_possession_prior_v1.parquet carries projected_team_off_possessions for all 2,990 team-games; measured 2,982 non-null / 8 NULL (pace_resolved=False, game_ids 1022100001-4, 2021 opening day). Those completed games sit in the trailing k=5 windows of early-2021 rows, so per-game dev is undefined there and the claim 'defined on all 2,982 rows in every fold' is false as written. Not leakage (no forward information), but a frozen-claim-vs-bytes contradiction plus an undeclared construction convention P36 would improvise. Fix: correct the claim and freeze the unresolved-prior-game handling identically in arm and null.

findings.title: L2: A23 bundle_AI 'previous SCHEDULED game' has no receipted pre-tip source (A06-parity violation)
findings.detail: The archive contains only played games at played dates; scheduled-but-not-completed games do not exist in any receipted artifact (the draft itself measured no schedule artifact in scope when conditioning A06). bundle_AI is therefore unimplementable as written; an implementation silently substitutes the completed-game definition (= bundle_OM's), making the claimed bundle distinction vacuous. No forward leakage either way, but the same evidentiary standard that made A06 INADMISSIBLE-UNTIL-RECEIPTED must apply: redefine to COMPLETED games or make bundle_AI conditional on the schedule receipt.

findings.title: L3: A06 repair path (b) admits an unreviewed feature definition after the red team
findings.detail: Path (a) and the PREREGISTERED_CONDITIONAL_NOT_FIT exclusion are decidable and leak-free; path (b) ('redefinition from past-only schedule facts') names no concrete formula, so its leak status cannot be adjudicated today. P35 must bind path (b) to a hash-pinned formula, per-column S8/P2A adjudication, P22 invocation, and a permanent record that the P34 leakage review did not see it.

findings.title: L4: A13 centering constant cbar_F not pinned to training-only computation
findings.detail: A01/A04 pin m_bar as training-fold-only; A13's (cont_i - cbar_F)*dev_prev treatment never defines cbar_F in SPEC.json or REPORT.md. If computed over the whole fold it would embed post-cutoff lineup information in training features — the only remaining construction where a cutoff violation is possible by omission. Fix is one frozen sentence: cbar_F and the n=0 imputation constant are TRAINING-row means, identical in arm and null.

findings.title: L5: A19 live-ball dictionary question is decidable now — withdrawal will fire
findings.detail: Measured end_reason levels (9 total) include a single undifferentiated 'turnover' level and no live-ball/steal distinction; A19's E_LB subset cannot be expressed and its preregistered withdrawal-as-design-failure fires at P35. A20 unaffected. Fail-closed behavior is leak-free; denominator consequence belongs to the multiplicity reviewer.

findings.title: L6: two leak-free determinism gaps (A26 LOO as-of date; A08 last-K date tie-break)
findings.detail: Both readings in each case use only strictly-earlier games — no leakage — but they yield different numbers; pin one at P35.

findings.title: L7: design constants frozen from pooled full-archive feature marginals
findings.detail: A03 t=3, A08 {20,80}, A16 k=5 were justified from all-season feature marginals (depth histogram re-measured and matches exactly: {0:37, 3-9:76 each, 10:2413}, SHALLOW=113). Outcome-free and conventional, but fold-1 designs are not fold-blind and the record should say so.

findings.title: L8: self-frozen quasi-Poisson IRLS convention is leakage-inert
findings.detail: The mean structure (log link + receipted log_exposure offset) is receipted and its line citations verified against possession_features.py bytes; the family choice affects only training-row IRLS weights and no likelihood-based SE is consumed (all inference is cluster bootstrap). No pre-tip availability channel. Whether freezing an unreceipted family is acceptable convention-invention is another reviewer's lens.

required_changes: Correct A16's retrievability claim (2,982 of 2,990 rows non-null, 8 opening-day rows NULL) and freeze the handling of trailing windows containing an unresolved prior game, identically in arm and null (L1).

Redefine A23 bundle_AI's prior-game rule to 'previous COMPLETED same-season game' OR make bundle_AI conditional on the same preseason-published schedule receipt as A06 path (a), with its element leaving the schedule_context_family denominator if the receipt does not land (L2).

Bind A06 repair path (b) at P35 to a concrete hash-pinned formula with per-column S8/P2A adjudication and P22 invocation, plus a recorded note that the P34 leakage review did not review the redefined feature (L3).
Pin A13's cbar_F and its n=0 imputation constant as TRAINING-fold-row means only, identical in arm and null (L4).

findings.title: A01 cannot pass the frozen offset guard truthfully
findings.detail: A01's treatment (log_exposure - m_bar) is exactly affine in the offset (R2=1.0 every fold, measured). Frozen guard run live: SUBSTANTIVE blocks with 7 kinds; RECALIBRATION with truthful k0_carries_offset_slope=False blocks (recalibration_family_incomplete); only a FALSE attestation of k0_carries_offset_slope=True passes, contradicting A01's preregistered null '[log_exposure] with slope fixed at 1'. Arm unfittable as preregistered; withdraw or adjudicate above the node.

findings.title: A04 blocked by frozen guard under BOTH declared families
findings.detail: Complete design [offset | 1[SHALLOW] | centered slope | interaction] measured against frozen guard bytes: SUBSTANTIVE blocks (calibration_parameter_in_substantive_arm on the nuisance slope column plus rank/reconstruction kinds); RECALIBRATION with full declaration blocks (mixed_family_arm: 1[SHALLOW] and the interaction are not functions of the offset/projection). No passing invocation exists at all. Arm unfittable as preregistered.

findings.title: P25 invocation under-specified: declared_family frozen nowhere
findings.detail: P33 freezes neither declared_family nor the recalibration_declaration payload for any of the 26 arms; arm_kind 'calibration_only' does not map onto the guard's SUBSTANTIVE/RECALIBRATION axis (A02 passes only under SUBSTANTIVE, measured; invoked as RECALIBRATION it blocks with mixed_family_arm). P35 must pin per-arm.

findings.title: 'Preregistered intercept structure' referenced everywhere, defined nowhere
findings.detail: P30 core_rules, P32 and P33 all use the phrase without enumerating it. No-intercept reading: K0_MATCHED[A01] IS the incumbent and m_bar is load-bearing (defines the one-parameter family's pivot). Free-intercept reading: m_bar is cosmetic but K0 is a refit, not the incumbent, changing what delta_MAE measures and breaking the exact-recovery gloss. Must be pinned per arm and null at P35.

findings.title: Quasi-Poisson freeze does not dispose of V2's retirement of Poisson GLMs
findings.detail: V2_STOP_CONDITION retired 'count/Poisson GLMs (target dispersion ratio 0.193)'; P33 borrows the 0.193 figure from that exact note while freezing quasi-Poisson IRLS, without stating why the retirement does not bind. The disposal exists (retired as replacement point-estimator families vs used here as a symmetric testing scaffold; constant under-dispersion cancels from the score equations; no likelihood SEs used) and must be written at P35.

findings.title: Exact-recovery gloss loose; containment is the true premise
findings.detail: Nulls with free parameters (A04, A07, A11-A15) do not recover the incumbent exactly when fitted; the link-pinning property is that every null FAMILY CONTAINS the incumbent, which forces link=log identically. Conclusion unaffected; restate at P35.

findings.title: Citation (3) is a turnover-lane sentence
findings.detail: GATE_INVOCATION_CONTRACT 3.1 reads 'every TURNOVER arm carries log(exposure) (and log(D)) in the offset'; P33 calls it program-wide. Corroborative only; citations (1)+(2) carry the derivation.

findings.title: A02 identity is by construction, with one unstated caveat
findings.detail: Blend identity own+opp==2*projected is a producer invariant (build_projected_exposure.py 320-328, fails closed unless exactly 2 sides); offset cluster-constant (all 1,491 games, measured); gap antisymmetric (max per-game sum 0.0). Exact orthogonality is conditional on games-never-split; any cluster-splitting subset voids the exact zero and must not quote the 0.0.

findings.title: A02 'blend weight' interpretation is first-order only
findings.detail: Nonzero gamma gives mu = P*exp(gamma*gap), a multiplicative surrogate rather than a natural-scale reweighted blend; gamma=0 recovery is exact.

findings.title: m_bar fold-safe; load-bearing under the no-intercept reading
findings.detail: Training-only centering, no leakage channel; measured per fold 4.374304-4.378700 (range 0.0044). A04's interaction is immune to m_bar shifts because the SHALLOW main absorbs them exactly.

findings.title: A02 contrast prereg record mismatch (name and audit offset)
findings.detail: P25 PREREGISTERED_CONTRASTS.json registers 'contrast_own_minus_opp_pace_estimate' audited against the NATURAL-scale projection; P33 names the column pace_gap and invokes with offset=log_exposure. As-is the guard's formula-reproduction check never fires. Reconcile at P35.

Resolve A04 guard-invocability identically (no passing invocation exists under either declared family)

findings.title: K1: A11 K0 block self-contradictory; two-mains null reading breaks nesting; rho-interval kill can never fire
findings.detail: Formula ('null fixes rho == 1') plus the frozen P26 hierarchical_pooling kind prescribe null = offset + beta*dblend(1); the k0_matched gloss '[log_exposure | dcur_t | dprev_t]' in the document's own column-list notation is a 2-free-df null not in the arm's span (dblend weights vary by row), violating 'every null is term_removal or parameter_fixed_at_null' and handing the NULL a flexibility advantage. The kill 'rho interval includes 1' is unproducible: rho is fixed per grid element {0.25,0.5,0.75}, only beta gets bootstrap intervals, and any grid distribution is bounded by 0.75 < 1. Pin the null, strike the gloss, replace the kill — or withdraw A11.

findings.title: K2: 'the preregistered intercept structure' is never preregistered; default-intercept channel recreates S4
findings.detail: A01/A03/A06 nulls cite an intercept structure defined nowhere in P33 (the preregistration itself) or any upstream frozen document — all defer to 'the preregistered' one. Formulas carry no intercept (coherent zero-parameter nulls), but P26 says the null CARRIES it. If a P36 implementer's GLM adds a default intercept to arm designs while nulls are coded as bare offset per the literal glosses, arms gain a free recalibration intercept their nulls lack — the exact P2/S4 defect. Must pin per arm, identically arm-and-null, before P35.

findings.title: K3: frozen P26 K0-contract validator cannot consume or pass the P33 K0 declarations
findings.detail: Schema: P33 k0_matched blocks lack every structured field validate_k0_matched.py reads. Substance: R8 requires calibration_only arms to declare a slope-role parameter with null_value exactly 1.0; A01/A04 declare slope with null 0 (delta parameterization), A02/A03/A05/A06 declare no slope role at all. GATE_INVOCATION_CONTRACT.md never mentions P26 (zero grep matches), so no frozen document names who enforces the K0 contract at fit time. P35 must emit P26-schema records with the equivalence adjudicated, or supersede P26 on the record.

findings.title: K4: A08's d_t league-mean window unpinned across the K grid — shared-K0 status undecidable
findings.detail: If d_t's inner 'lagged league mean' is all-prior (D6 suggests so), both K elements {20,80} share one null [offset | d_t] identical to A09/A10's — fair. If trailing-K, the two elements carry different nulls, 'identical machinery' claims across A08/A09/A10 break, and the frozen A04/A09 collapse test no longer speaks for A08's columns. One pinning sentence needed at P35.

findings.title: K5: 'incumbent structural terms' misnomer for gap/depth/opp_depth in A07/A12/A14 nulls
findings.detail: possession_features.py bytes: the incumbent has no fitted feature and pace_gap is explicitly the part that does NOT enter the projection. These nulls are deliberately stronger than the incumbent (S6 direction 1) and symmetric with their arms — no unfairness — but the label invites P36 to claim the nulls 'recover the incumbent' or to read MAE(K0) as an incumbent benchmark. Relabel.

findings.title: K6: n_i clock is the contract schedule including D010-excluded games — reproducibly so, but stated nowhere
findings.detail: P33's A03/A07 collapse and A07-absorption numbers reproduce exactly (4 dp every fold) only when n_i counts strictly-earlier same-season rows of the 2,990-row prior artifact including the four excluded 2021 opening-day games; universe-row clock gives materially different bytes (fold-2 R2 0.3674 vs 0.3321). Verdicts unchanged. Pin the clock in one frozen sentence so P36 builds the preregistered feature.

findings.title: K7: no symmetric rule for degenerate bootstrap draws or one-sided IRLS non-convergence
findings.detail: Fully-empty indicator draws are measured-negligible (worst case ~8e-12, A03 fold 1), but near-degenerate draws and the 100-iteration cap can break one member of an arm/null pair only. Direction is conservative (widens arm intervals, favors kills) but behavior is implementation-defined. Declare one symmetric NA-both-members rule at P35; also covers A09's formula-vs-treatment_terms drafting gap (both readings give the identical null there, unlike A11).

findings.title: K8: A23's two bundles have per-bundle nulls with potentially different evaluable sets in one Holm family
findings.detail: bundle_AI's opener rule is an S7 fold-level fallback (can change evaluability, arm-and-null identically); bundle_OM's is deterministic. Fair per element and declared; record so family Holm is not read as like-for-like row sets.

findings.title: A08 window-definedness constraint unsatisfiable for both K in every fold
findings.detail: SPEC freezes both 'rows defined once >= K league games completed' and 'K elements must keep L_t defined on all rows of every training fold'. Measured: L_t undefined on 44 training rows (K=20) and 162 (K=80, 39.5% of fold-1 training) in EVERY fold. As written both grid elements fail at invocation, evaporating A08 post-freeze and silently changing the timeseries_shrinkage Holm denominator. Fix at P35: freeze explicit pre-window-row handling (identical in arm and null) or withdraw now.

findings.title: A16/A17/A19/A21 definedness claims refuted by bytes (7 zero-prior rows)
findings.detail: Measured against the possessions archive (the lag operator's actual source; all 8 excluded opening-day team-games do carry possession rows): exactly 7 universe rows have zero strictly-earlier possession games for the offense team — four 2021-05-15 rows plus three expansion debuts; 5 clusters/10 rows for symmetric/contrast constructions; 1 is a fold-4 TEST row and 2 are fold-5 TEST rows. A16's 'defined on all 2,982 rows', A17's '|P|>=1 by universe construction', A19/A21's 'defined on every row' are false. Undefined treatment on a test row means the arm cannot predict it while its null can — undeclared row-set asymmetry. Freeze a deterministic symmetric |P|=0 rule per arm (A22's churn:=0 is the model).

findings.title: A14 Holm-slot handling unpinned; diagnostic arm can block real promotions
findings.detail: SPEC retains A14's slot ('test is still performed') but never states whether its p enters the Holm step-down ordering. If it does, an intermediate A14 non-rejection stops the sequence and can deny A07/A12/A13/A15 tests they would pass at m=4 — promotion made dependent on a promotion-ineligible, franchise-confounded p-value. Recommend pinning the fixed-slot reading (charged to m, excluded from ordering) at P35.

findings.title: A14 licensing omits single-franchise confound; effective support 9-15 clusters
findings.detail: Measured: all 46 expansion training clusters in train_lt_2026 belong to ONE franchise (1611661331, 2025); test-side expansion rows are 57 across two DIFFERENT franchises. kappa-hat is unidentifiable against that franchise's idiosyncratic level. Clusters with decayed treatment >= 0.05 number 15 (>= 0.2: 9) vs 46 nominal. Restated kills verified decidable, but PRELIMINARY_SUPPORTED_SINGLE_FOLD must carry the confound and effective-support caveats. Retention in fit set justified only jointly with this and the Holm pin; otherwise drop A14 and shrink the family to 4 openly.

findings.title: A11 fold-1 fallback names a mechanism, not a rule; evaluability undefined
findings.detail: Measured: train_lt_2022 training = 2021 season only; dprev_t undefined on 100% of fold-1 training rows. A11 invokes GATE_INVOCATION_CONTRACT section 4 but freezes none of its menu options, and leaves undefined whether fold 1 enters pooled delta_MAE (dilution by 478 test rows if the column drops) or counts as 'evaluable' for the rho-interval kill. Bring to the A12/A13/A05 standard: name the option and the evaluability, before P35.

findings.detail: ACTIVE_SET_RULE_PREREGISTRATION.json (hash-pinned by P33, cited as A03's operative fallback and mirrored by A04/A12/A13/A14) states it is a reference instance that each arm must register in the arm registry before execution. P33 creates no registration obligation. P35 task cards must register S7_TIER_SUPPORT_v1 per invoking arm, else fold deactivations rest on an unregistered fallback that section 4 treats as invalidating.

findings.title: A12/A13 P27-at-invocation deferral is sound; risk negligible
findings.detail: The deferred >= 10-cluster |dev_prev|>0 floors in folds 2-5 have a schedule-fact lower bound of hundreds of clusters (every such fold contains a full season whose teams all have an archived prior season). Fold-1 structural deactivation verified as schedule fact. Recommend P35 record the lower bound so invocation is confirmation, not decision.

findings.title: P27 rule is training-side only; test-side blind spot patched ad hoc for A05 alone
findings.detail: The rule conditions on 'training-fold counts only'. A05's fold-5 test degeneracy (0 playoff test rows — verified) got a bespoke decidable trigger, but no general test-side degeneracy rule exists. Measured today no other arm has a fully test-degenerate fold (A03 test shallow rows 12/12/12/16/21; A14 fold-5 test exp rows 57), so record-level this cycle.

findings.title: A03 verified; per-fold test-side discrimination rests on 12-21 rows
findings.detail: Training support and t=3 rationale premises reproduced exactly (24/36/46/57/69 shallow train clusters; no depth-1/2 rows). SPEC omits test-side support: 12/12/12/16/21 shallow test rows (2.5-4.9%). Power risk already declared by the arm; recorded so a null is read as underpowered-stratum evidence.

findings.title: No rule for degenerate bootstrap draws or IRLS non-convergence in a draw
findings.detail: B=2000 refit bootstrap has no frozen disposition for a draw losing a thin stratum or hitting max iterations. Quantified negligible for current arms (zero-playoff fold-1 draw ~ e^-17; shallow ~ e^-24; expansion ~ e^-46). Completeness item for P35 cards.

findings.title: Provenance rule manufactures a partition no source proposed; F14/F15/F18 mechanisms double-funded with no dual check
findings.detail: F14 (A17/A18), F15 (A19/A20), F18 (A23/A24) are each one P32-adjudicated mechanism charged to two multiplicity families with independent 0.05 budgets. Under every one of the three P32 source readings of the F18 rest mechanism, A23 and A24 co-locate with denominator >= 3; the frozen split (A24 singleton at uncorrected 0.05) appears in no reading and is weakly more lenient than all of them — inverting stricter-governs exactly where a dispute exists. P33's dual-Holm covers only the D2/D5 arms; the seven CONFLICTING-ADJACENT arms (A17-A20, A23-A25) get pure provenance.

findings.title: D2 three-way dispute reduced to two-way; A06's dual check is mathematically vacuous
findings.detail: D2 records CAL vs temporal_drift vs COLDSTART (CF-H3). P33 checks A06 under CAL and temporal_drift only; temporal_drift_family as constituted is A06's own 2 elements, a strict subset of the CAL run, and by Holm's closed-testing structure a subset family is never the binding check. The only alternate that could bind (A06 into COLDSTART) is omitted, so 'Neither reading is erased' is false in operation.

findings.title: Dual-Holm alternate compositions unpinned; stricter-governs stops at the disputed arm
findings.detail: Whether other disputed arms are held at primary during an alternate run is unstated (D5 moves A11 and A12/A13 in opposite directions between the same two families — four configurations, different Holm outcomes); A06-conditional-element interplay with A07's CAL-alternate run is unstated. Non-disputed members of enlarged families (A01-A05 under CAL+A07=8; A08-A10 under timeseries+A12/A13=12) are never re-corrected at the larger denominator — the anti-conservative direction.

findings.title: Grid-element semantics contradictory: fitted-element Holm vs fold-local training selection; no multi-survivor rule
findings.detail: The partition rule defines Holm over 'fitted elements (arm x enumerated-grid-element)' but A09 says kappa is 'fold-locally fit' and A10 says lambda is 'fold-locally selected' on training rows — under selection, element identity varies by fold and per-element pooled p-values do not exist, so the frozen procedure has no inputs. A06's two bases are joined by 'OR'. No preregistered rule selects the promotable element when several elements of one arm survive Holm.

findings.title: Kill-condition alpha accounting self-contradictory; 'conservative direction' rationale backwards for failure-to-reject kills
findings.detail: inference.coefficient_inference freezes kills as UNCORRECTED while six arm records (A01-A06) freeze 'family-corrected X = 0 not rejected' kills. Both cannot be implemented. For failure-to-reject kills, uncorrected evaluation fires FEWER kills than corrected — the anti-conservative direction; the damage is bounded by the corrected primary gate but the bytes contradict each other.

findings.title: LAGGED_TEMPO_MIX drop rule and A13 fixed-sequence gate cited but specified nowhere
findings.detail: The families block cites a 'preregistered weaker-member drop rule (A19.k0_matched declaration)'; measured, that declaration contains no drop/weaker language — no statistic, stage, or post-drop alpha (Holm-2 at 0.025 vs uncorrected 0.05 is exactly a max-selection charge). A13's gate 'confirmatory only if A12's joint treatment rejects' states no rejection level (uncorrected vs Holm vs dual-stricter) and no denominator rule for the exploratory case.

findings.title: No both-pass adjudication; A03/A07 answer; program-wide alpha silent
findings.detail: A03/A07 is not formal double funding under frozen semantics (distinct F-ids, collapse rule executed honestly: max fold R2 0.7134, spearman 0.5141, far below 0.998001/0.999), but the collapse criterion is an identifiability threshold, not a mechanism-identity test: at R2 ~0.71 in the fold where both cold-start claims live, with A03's null owning no depth information, the two tests overlap on the same signal across two family budgets, and if both pass the record licenses promoting both. Same both-pass exposure for A17/A18, A19/A20, A23/A24. 10 families at 0.05 give up to ~0.40-0.50 global false-funding under the null; no program-wide statement exists anywhere in the frozen bytes.

findings.title: A03 'no other element is defensible' overstated
findings.detail: t=3 is genuinely anchored and honestly charged, but WINDOW_K=10 is accepted elsewhere in the same document (A09's kappa anchor) as frozen evidence, so a depth threshold at the window cap is defensible by the identical argument form. Count unaffected.

findings.title: A08 {20,80} and A16 k=5 justifications constructed, not sourced — honestly charged
findings.detail: Source text for A08 is only '(K small, preregistered)' (HYPOTHESES_timeseries_shrinkage.md:183); A16's source names no k and delegates accounting ('one preregistered k is fitted'). Counts charged honestly pre-fit with no performance data; the 'discharged from source' framing overstates the derivation, not the count.

findings.title: Quasi-Poisson freeze is multiplicity-neutral only because global and irrevocable
findings.detail: The un-receipted response-family freeze charges nothing under this lens (single pre-fit convention, no searched dimension, no likelihood SE consumed). Recommend a P35 clause that any per-arm response-family/objective deviation at P36 voids the arm, paralleling the stochastic-fitting clause.

findings.title: Verified sound: budget arithmetic, pre-fit alpha statement, A14 slot, granularity, A23 cross-product refusal
findings.detail: 26 arms each in exactly one family; charge = max(grid,1) all 26; sums match; A14 Holm slot retention conservative; conditional-element timing well-defined; bootstrap min p ~2.0e-4 clears worst Holm threshold 0.05/12 ~4.2e-3 with margin; A23's two source-consistent bundles correctly refuse the 8-cell cross-product.

required_changes: P35: co-locate F14/F15/F18 in one multiplicity family each per stricter-governs, OR extend dual-Holm stricter-governs to A17, A18, A19, A20, A23, A24, A25 with pinned alternate compositions, OR expressly disclaim mechanism-level multiplicity semantics and acknowledge additive mechanism funding rates.

findings.title: Regulation-equivalent rescale of lagged realized pace unpinned for A08-A11, ambiguous for A12/A16
findings.detail: Target and archived projection are period-based regulation-equivalent (measured: n_off*40/(40+5*max(0,max_period-4)), re-derivation dev 0.0). A08-A11 define d_t/pace(j) as 'realized regulation-equivalent pace' with no construction formula anywhere; D9 pins conventions only for A12/A16/A26. A16's wording ('regulation-equivalent duration from lagged duration_sec/period aggregates') and A12's ('lagged duration/overtime columns') admit a duration_sec-based normalizer that differs from the target/projection convention; under that reading A16's dev residual carries a systematic convention artifact on lagged-OT games. Not leakage, not a K0-parity break, but a post-preregistration unit-construction judgment call P32's F8 explicitly instructed be closed. Fix at P35: pin all six arms to the lagged target-column construction; A26 stays raw per D9 (pinning is completing a spec, not harmonizing).

findings.title: Quasi-Poisson coherent on the continuous target; dispersion heterogeneity caveat recorded
findings.detail: Verified: min target 66 > 0, no NaN, 120/2982 (4.02%) non-integer rows; quasi-score and deviance defined everywhere, IRLS well-posed. Caveat: the OT rescale makes per-row quasi-dispersion heterogeneous (phi*40/g, factors {1, 8/9, 4/5, 2/3}), so IRLS weights are mildly mis-specified on the 4.4% OT rows; identical in arm and null, bootstrap-immune. 'Dispersion irrelevant' means the constant-phi factor cancels, not that the variance model is right.
